sentences.text: Dr. Anjali Gyanani, learned Public Prosecutor for the  respondent no.1/State.

It appears that the appellant has challenged the order passed by the Appellate Tribunal and Adjudicating Authority, but by mistake it is mentioned as second appeal, and therefore, it is listed as second appeal of civil side, though second appeal is not permitted.

The appellant is directed to modify the memo of appeal according to the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 within 10 days from today, failing which it shall be presumed that he does not want to prosecute the present appeal.

(N.K. Gupta) Judge pawar/-
